en: A sepia-toned photographic portrait of two women in late 19th or early 20th-century attire. Both women are wearing modest, high-collared dresses with elaborate detailing. They are posed indoors, with one woman seated and the other standing, resting her arm on a rustic wooden prop. There is a plain curtain as the backdrop, and the photo is cropped into an oval shape. The number '6/11' is handwritten at the bottom of the image.
